item.title: Choosing line length depending on the font size
item.description: As discussions in An Ideal Page: Line length, Leading, Margins, Page Size, Etc. and Cyrillic (Russian) ideal number of characters per line go, the topics discussed make absolutely no sense to me. Discussing the “optimal number of characters on line” begs the question — it presumes that when one increases font size by a certain percentage, the optimal line length should increase by the same percentage. And I find this presumption silly.
